rules.name: Flow of Magic
rules.html:
Certain areas of the battlefield are within your army’s Flow of Magic, as follows:

  • Your deployment zone is always within your army’s Flow of Magic.
  • At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within No Man’s Land, until the end of that phase, No Man’s Land is within your army’s Flow of Magic.
  • At the start of any phase, if you control at least half of the objective markers within your opponent’s deployment zone, until the end of that phase, your opponent’s deployment zone is within your army’s Flow of Magic.

Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes a Psychic Attack, re‑roll a Wound roll of 1. If such a model is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, each time it makes a Psychic Attack, add 1 to the Wound roll instead.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control, if that objective marker is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Command phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit is destroyed, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic: on a 4+, do not remove it from play. That destroyed model can fight after the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: That THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army Falls Back.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. If your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic when it is targeted with this Stratagem, then until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One RUBRIC MARINES or SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit from your army that is in Strategic Reserves.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Start of the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: If it is a RUBRIC MARINES unit, until the end of the phase, it has the Deep Strike ability. When your unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, if it is a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATOR unit it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic and more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models.

parts.label: Restriction
parts.html: If a SCARAB OCCULT TERMINATORS unit is targeted with this Stratagem, it is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase and is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Shooting phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [IGNORES COVER] ability. After your unit has shot this phase, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit cannot have the Benefit of Cover.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, your unit has the Stealth ability, and, if your unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, each time an attack targets your unit, it has the Benefit of Cover against that attack.

enhancements.name: Arcane Might
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in the bearer’s unit. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, add 2 to the Strength characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in that unit instead.

enhancements.name: Empowered Manifestation
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, you can add 6" to the range of Psychic abilities the bearer has that specify a range (including Rituals) and each time a model in the bearer’s unit takes a Hazardous test for a Psychic weapon, you can re‑roll the result.

enhancements.name: Empyric Onslaught
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer’s unit is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

enhancements.name: Noctilith Mantle
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer’s unit is on the battlefield, it is wholly within your army’s Flow of Magic. Models in that unit cannot be selected to use any Rituals.

rules.name: Infernal Pacts
rules.html:
SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army have the following the ability:

Daemonic Illusions (Aura): While a friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit is within 6" of and visible to this unit, models in that unit have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

THOUSAND SONS units from your army have the following ability:

Mortal Sorcery (Aura): While a friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS PSYKER unit is within 6" of and visible to this unit, that SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit has the Cabal of Sorcerers ability.

rules.name: Restrictions
rules.html:
You can include SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units in your army, even though they do not have the THOUSAND SONS Faction keyword. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:

Incursion: Up to 500 pts Strike Force: Up to 1000 pts Onslaught: Up to 1500 pts

No SCINTILLATING LEGIONS models from your army can be your WARLORD.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Start of the Fight phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, each time an enemy model within Engagement Range of your unit selects targets for its attacks, it can only target your unit if there are no eligible SCINTILLATING LEGIONS targets for those attacks.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that is within 9" of that enemy unit and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Movement phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D6", or a Normal move of up to 6" instead if it is wholly within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS units.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, your unit can only be selected as the target of a ranged attack if the attacking model is within 18".

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit from your army that was selected as a target of that charge.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit has declared a charge.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for that enemy unit (this is not cumulative with any other negative modifiers to that Charge roll).

parts.label: Target
parts.html: Up to two SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units from your army (excluding MONSTERS), or one SCINTILLATING LEGIONS MONSTER unit from your army, if all of those units are more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units.

parts.label: When
parts.html: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Remove those units from the battlefield and place them into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Nethershriek Mind-Eater
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the bearer. That unit must take a Battle-shock test; if that test is failed, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

enhancements.name: Diabolic Savant
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly SCINTILLATING LEGIONS units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, add 1 to the Psychic test result.

enhancements.name: Duplicitous Malediction
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS or LORD OF CHANGE model only. After both players have deployed their armies, select up to three THOUSAND SONS units from your army and redeploy them. When doing so, you can set those units up in Strategic Reserves if you wish, regardless of how many units are already in Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Tome of True Names
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. Once per battle, at the start of any phase, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, until the end of the phase, the bearer has a 2+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Kindred Sorcery
rules.html:
In your Command phase, you can select one of the abilities listed below to take effect until the start of your next Command phase. You can only select each of these abilities once per battle.

Imbued Manifestation

Add 6" to the Range characteristic of ranged Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army.

Psychic Maelstrom

Each time a THOUSAND SONS model from your army makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.

Wrath of the Immaterium

Psychic weapons equipped by THOUSAND SONS models from your army have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Any phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, all attacks made against your unit with Psychic weapons have the [HAZARDOUS] ability and all models in your unit have the Feel No Pain 4+ ability against Psychic Attacks.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: That PSYKER model.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Any phase, just after a saving throw is failed for a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army. If you are using fast dice rolling, this Stratagem can still be used after rolling multiple saving throws at once.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Change the Damage characteristic of that attack to 0. If you are using fast dice rolling, select one of those attacks you failed a saving throw for.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Command phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Select the Imbued Manifestation, Psychic Maelstrom or Wrath of the Immaterium ability (see Kindred Sorcery). Until the start of your next Command phase, that ability applies to your unit instead of any other Kindred Sorcery ability, even if you have already selected that ability this battle.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Command phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: That objective marker remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: That THOUSAND SONS model.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Shooting phase, just after you take a Psychic test for a THOUSAND SONS model from your army that Channelled the Warp (before resolving that Ritual).

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Re-roll all of the D6 rolled for that Psychic test (including the additional D6 for Channelling the Warp).

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Shooting phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, add 9" to the Range characteristic of Psychic weapons equipped by models in your unit, and each time a model in your unit makes an attack with a Psychic weapon, you can re-roll the Hit roll and you can re-roll the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Lord of Forbidden Lore
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. Each time the bearer manifests a Ritual, while resolving that Ritual, add 6" to its range.

enhancements.name: Incandaeum
enhancements.html: EXALTED SORCERER model only. Once per battle, when selecting a Ritual for the bearer to attempt, you can select Doombolt, even if a model from your army has already attempted to manifest that Ritual this phase.

enhancements.name: Umbralefic Crystal
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. Once per battle, in your Command phase, if the bearer’s unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, you can remove that unit from the battlefield and place it into Strategic Reserves. In the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, set that unit back up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: Eldritch Vortex of E’Taph
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. Add 1 to the Strength and Damage characteristics of Psychic weapons equipped by the bearer.

rules.name: All is Dust
rules.html: Each time an attack with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to a RUBRICAE model from your army, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: That RUBRICAE unit.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Movement phase, just after a RUBRICAE unit from your army Falls Back.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One RUBRICAE unit from your army.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Movement phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the turn, your unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic and to Advance rolls made for it, and ranged weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [ASSAULT] ability.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Shooting phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, all inferno bolt pistols, inferno boltguns, inferno combi‑bolters and inferno combi‑weapons equipped by models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and a Strength characteristic of 5.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One RUBRICAE unit from your army that was within 6" of that PSYKER model when it was destroyed.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army is destroyed.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: After the attacking unit has shot, your RUBRICAE unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but when resolving those attacks it can only target the enemy unit that just destroyed your PSYKER model (and only if it is an eligible target).

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One RUBRIC MARINES PSYKER unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack is allocated to a model in your unit (excluding PSYKER models), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One RUBRIC MARINES unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the turn, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.

enhancements.name: Risen Rubricae
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. At the start of the Declare Battle Formations step, select either two RUBRICAE BATTLELINE units from your army or one other RUBRICAE unit from your army; models in the selected units have the Infiltrators ability.

enhancements.name: Arcane Thralls (Aura)
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. While a friendly RUBRICAE unit is within 9" of the bearer, you can re-roll Battle-shock tests taken for that unit.

enhancements.name: Lord of the Rubricae
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time a RUBRICAE model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Stave Abominus
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. The bearer’s melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS D3] and [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] abilities.

rules.name: Warpmeld Sacrifice
rules.html:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot or fight and one or more TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY or TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED units from your army are selected as a target of one or more of those attacks, each of those TZEENTCH MUTANT units can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that TZEENTCH MUTANT unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

Each time a TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY or TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, before selecting its targets, that unit can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that TZEENTCH MUTANT unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Keywords
rules.html: TZAANGORS units from your army have the BATTLELINE keyword, and while such a unit is not Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of TZAANGOR models in that unit.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS CHARACTER model from your army (excluding MONSTERS) that was just destroyed. You can use this Stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Any phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: At the end of the phase, add one TZEENTCH CHAOS SPAWN unit containing one model to your army, and set it up as close as possible to where your model was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units.

parts.label: Restriction
parts.html: You can only use this Stratagem once per battle round.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One TZAANGORS unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have a 4+ invulnerable save.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: That TZEENTCH MUTANT unit.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Fight phase, just after a TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army is selected to fi ght.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, each time a model in your unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it can move up to 6" instead of up to 3", and when determining which models in it are eligible to fight, any models in it that are within 3" of one or more enemy models are eligible to fight. When resolving those attacks, such models can target one of those enemy units that is within 3" of them and within Engagement Range of their unit.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER model from your army, and one friendly TZAANGORS unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 12" of that PSYKER model.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Command phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Return up to D3+1 destroyed models (excluding CHARACTERS) to your TZAANGORS unit.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Start of your Movement phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the turn, your unit is eligible to shoot or declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One TZEENTCH MUTANT unit from your army that is arriving from Strategic Reserves this phase.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Reinforcements step of your Movement phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 3" horizontally away from all enemy units, or anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" horizontally away from all enemy units if it is a MONSTER unit. In either case, until the end of the turn, it is not eligible to declare a charge.

enhancements.name: Warpmeld Dagger
enhancements.html: TZAANGOR SHAMAN model only. Each time the bearer attempts a Ritual, just before determining the Psychic test result, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, the bearer suffers D3 mortal wounds; if it is not destroyed as a result, add 1 to that Psychic test result for each of those mortal wounds suffered.

enhancements.name: Diamond of Distortion
enhancements.html: TZAANGOR SHAMAN model only. While the bearer is leading a unit, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.

enhancements.name: Bray Lord
enhancements.html: SORCERER or INFERNAL MASTER model only. The bearer has the Scouts 6" ability. During the Declare Battle Formations step, the bearer can be attached to a TZAANGORS unit.

enhancements.name: Flowing Flesh
enhancements.html: TZAANGOR SHAMAN model only. The bearer has the Feel No Pain 4+ ability and a Wounds characteristic of 5.

rules.name: Warpfire Infusion
rules.html:
Each time a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:

  • If that VEHICLE unit is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll and one Damage roll.
  • Otherwise, you can re-roll one Hit roll, one Wound roll or one Damage roll.

Each time a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE model from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed while it is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER models, that model’s Deadly Demise ability inflicts mortal wounds on a D6 roll of 5+ instead of only a 6.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that was selected as the target of one or more of the attacking unit’s attacks.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the attacking unit has finished making its attacks, each time an attack targets your unit, worsen the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit from your army within range of an objective marker you control.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Command phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: That objective marker is mutated, and remains under your control until your opponent’s Level of Control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of a phase. While an objective marker is mutated and under your control, each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move within range of that objective marker, roll one D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: That VEHICLE unit, and one friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER unit within 6" of that VEHICLE unit.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Movement phase, just after a THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army Falls Back.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the turn, your VEHICLE unit is eligible to shoot and declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Command phase

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the start of your next Command phase, your VEHICLE unit is malevolent. While a unit is malevolent, it can ignore any or all modifiers to the following: the profile characteristics of its models; the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by its models; any roll or test made for it (excluding modifiers to saving throws).

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army that has not been selected to shoot this phase, that is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS PSYKER units.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your Shooting phase.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by VEHICLE models in your unit have the [PSYCHIC] ability and each time an attack is made with such a weapon, add 1 to the Wound roll.

parts.label: Target
parts.html: One THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE unit from your army within Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

parts.label: When
parts.html: Your opponent’s Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move.

parts.label: Effect
parts.html: Roll six D6: for each 5+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound. That enemy unit must then take a Battle-shock test.

enhancements.name: Warp Syphon
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE units, each time the bearer Channels the Warp, after you roll that additional D6 but before checking for doubles or triples, the bearer can use this Enhancement. If it does, select one of those VEHICLE units; that VEHICLE unit suffers 1 mortal wound and you can re-roll that additional D6.

enhancements.name: Perplexing Cloak
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS INFANTRY model only. While the bearer is within 3" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE units, the bearer has the Lone Operative ability

enhancements.name: Biomechanical Mutation
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. In your Command phase, you can select one friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE model within 6" of this model. That model regains up to D3 lost wounds.

enhancements.name: Warp-Cursed Runemaster
enhancements.html: THOUSAND SONS model only. While the bearer is within 6" of one or more friendly THOUSAND SONS VEHICLE units, each time the bearer manifests a Ritual, while resolving that Ritual, add 6" to its range.

army.name: Cabal of Sorcerers
army.html:
If your Army Faction is THOUSAND SONS, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals from those listed on the right. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test for that model by following the sequence below.

Psychic Test Sequence

Roll 2D6

Roll 2D6

Channel the Warp (Optional)

Optionally, you can roll one additional D6.

Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model’s unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.

Destiny’s Ruin (Psychic)Warp Charge - 5

Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 10+, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.

Temporal Surge (Psychic)Warp Charge - 6

Select one friendly THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS unit that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. That unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 10+, that unit can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead. In either case, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.

Doombolt (Psychic)Warp Charge - 7

Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model (excluding units with the Lone Operative ability that are not part of an Attached unit and are not within 12" of the manifesting model); that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 11+, that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds instead.

Twist of Fate (Psychic)Warp Charge - 9

Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a THOUSAND SONS or SCINTILLATING LEGIONS model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 12+, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.

army.name: Pact of Sorcery
army.html: When mustering your army, unless specifically stated otherwise, you cannot select SCINTILLATING LEGIONS as your Army Faction.
